DESCRIPTION.general.scan_timeout: Required finite positive number of seconds for iw scans, both the network list and selected-network details.
DESCRIPTION.network_summary_columns: Required. List of columns to include in the network summary table.
DESCRIPTION.network_summary_columns.<INDEX>: Configuration for a specific column in the network summary table.
DESCRIPTION.network_summary_columns.<INDEX>.name: Display name for the column.
DESCRIPTION.network_summary_columns.<INDEX>.key: Key to use when storing extracted data for this column.
DESCRIPTION.network_summary_columns.<INDEX>.pattern: Required string containing a Python regular expression applied to each stripped iw scan line. The first capture group is used when present, otherwise the complete match. Numeric-looking captures are converted to numbers.
DESCRIPTION.general.interface_timeout: Required finite positive number of seconds for iw dev interface discovery and its ip link fallback, including discovery during status inspection.
DESCRIPTION.general.status_timeout: Required finite positive number of seconds for each iw link status query.
